releaseNotes: v1.1.2+6: Added native multi-page PDF upload & rendering for Invoice, Price List, and Clerk OCR scanning; fixed handwritten 3-column (Item | Unit Price | Qty) offline extraction with baseline tilt recovery; upgraded background WorkManager alerts to run every 30 minutes even when the app is closed (overdue invoices, clerk dockets, payroll, recurring bills, statements, and updates).
